GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well , Settled Down Two Wide 9th 5 Lengths @ 650m. Hooked Out all Clear Straightening Up . Kept Finding line well # Sound finish
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider reported that after beginning only fairly, when a number of runners to his inside showed superior speed, he elected to ease the gelding back behind runners to avoid being caught wide and consequently settled further back than he had anticipated. Near the 300m was briefly held up before shifting out and making contact to secure clear running.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out .5 Lengths Went Forward to lead 2 Lengths 600m lead 1 Lengths Straightened Up 1st 2 Lengths tired badly final 150m # led/quick/tired
Led and was only reeled in late as an easing fave fresh. Take catching with the added fitness.

Began OK. Pushed fwd & shared lead on inside early . Stayed =lead on inside midrace & pushed to quicken =lead on inside on home turn. Pushed along 3 Wide @ cutaway & pressured @ 200m. Fought on until over-run late. # On-pace/tried hard

Bit Slow Out slipped behind, Restrained from Outside Settled Down 2nd last 9 Lengths held together much same to straightening up clear run home Outside Kept Trying but was Never Likely - # slow recovery
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported it was intended to settle in a prominent position and anticipated this would be near the lead, however his mnt appeared to slip behind on jumping and, as a result, lost ground at the start. He said from the outside barrier, when positioned back off the leading division, rather than continue to ride forward he eased mnt to obtain cover at rear of the field, whereby it never travelled at any stage of the race and was inclined to hang out. A post-race vet exam revealed the gelding to be slow to recover and to have sustained a superficial abrasion to the off-hind pastern.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok went to front. shared lead turn. got clear late # too good
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shortly after the start shifted in and tightened another rnr.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok pressed on to lead 1 length clear, held together turn, Straightened Up 1 length clear, still 1 length clear 100m, got tired, headed 50m # led/headed 50m
Jumped Well joint lead rail, niggled turn, joint lead Straightening Up , same 100m, headed 50m, kept on one pace # disappointing
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr was permitted to ride 1kg over the allotted weight of 55.5kg in accordance with the policy. Began awkwardly. When questioned, rdr stated that his mount raced flat today and was unbalanced when being placed under pressure in the home straight. A post-race veterinary examination of the colt revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away fairly. Pushed fwd to lead on rail by 2 Lengths early . Unchallenged in front midrace & slipped 3L clear on inside on home turn. Easily held them in straight. # Led - too good

Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 1 length on fence, held together much same to turn 2 Lengths rail, off heels Straightening Up and ran on in straight, dived but just missed. (Cross-over Nose Band ON) # just missed
